changed_rows.title: Make norm fusion's cast boundaries explicit rather than assuming all RMSNorms match
changed_rows.runtime_dependency: prohibited library; ideas only, no imports/copies

changed_rows.hardware_fit: Own FP32 SM75 reduction concept; actual CUDA reduction/division/rsqrt/FMA behavior and resource cost unmeasured.
changed_rows.semantic_risk: Expected fixed path: FP32 input/output and frozen FP32 affine; preserve true H=1536, epsilon, casts and actual needs_input_grad. Compact backward is not universally floating-point equivalent. Even an atomic standalone custom norm can regroup direct/variance/bypass accumulation in a residual-connected graph. Two-output fusion must distinguish unused None from connected-zero gradients and preserve rounded residual, aliases and version checks.

Native 5 saved refs and custom 3 refs both retain 3 x/r/w storages. Actual-width1536 cancellation yields expanded native0 versus regrouped1; unused norm branch zero-materialization can introduce NaN where baseline bypass gradient1. No signed-zero/payload/GPU/whole-training proof.

required_proof: Observe actual prepared FP32 input/weight, frozen affine, epsilon, true width, strides and forward identity; unsupported/trainable/no-grad paths preserve reference and do not force state or gradients.

Compare norm inside original residual-connected expanded graph, not just isolated module: custom backward granularity may change InputBuffer accumulation. H1536 native0/regrouped1 witness prevents universal lossless-fusion claims.

For two outputs preserve rounded FP32 residual and norm value, both alias edges, independent consumers, saved version checks and unused None versus connected-zero semantics. No in-place corruption or raw-ctx workaround.

Storage inventory must deduplicate storage and account for actual liveness: baseline already retains x/r/w, and no-grad input/frozen weight saves nothing. Reconstructing x from output or saving half x is not lossless by definition. Recompute-r variant stays P3 pending actual reduction parity and cost.
Original useful Triton normal launches plus full unchanged T4 loss/metrics/adapter/quality/time/memory/own-share gates; no performance coordinates from CPU.

changed_rows.verdict_reason: Shared transfer-constraint correction only; relates to attn-sgl-rounding-fusion apply-only variant, not an additional implementation or independent measured result.
required_proof: Observe actual fixed-task CUDA q/k/cos/sin dtypes, projection-transposed strides and reference output stride, requires_grad, cache mode and decorator/SDPA routing. Source-expected FP32 is not a measured runtime boundary.

Own out-of-place half-split application only, no QK norm/interleaved pairs/FP8/early-half substitution. Preserve original cos/sin generation shared once per model forward; no copied/imported hub kernels.

Forward separate multiply/add rounding; adjoint cross-half terms dx1=g1*c1+g2*s2, dx2=g2*c2-g1*s1 with source order. Compile and inspect actual SM75 no-contraction behavior; a compiler flag alone is not proof.

Preserve observed output layout or separately prove downstream routing/cost invariance. Handle independent q/k gradient needs and unused None; trainable coefficients, unsupported/mixed dtypes/layouts/axes/configurations use baseline. Higher-order/signed-zero/nonfinite behavior is not covered by current finite CPU tests.

Save coefficient references with version checks, not q/k clones. Baseline already saves two unique coefficient storages; reference count reduction is not peak-memory saving and coefficient payload must not be multiplied by28 layers.

Measure total forward+backward, allocations/layout/SDPA costs, separate versus combined q/k variants and cold compilation, then unchanged full T4 gates and collective own-share. No candidate coordinates until genuine measured evidence.
changed_rows.next_action: Reuse primary RoPE contract as source transfer constraint; do not implement source QK-norm/FP8 recipe or count a separate candidate.
